days.title: Canyon River and Historic Landmarks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: río Lobos
stops.detail: The Lobos River is the axis of the canyon of the same name and the cause of the erosion that shaped it.

stops.name: Cueva Grande
stops.detail: This area is located 3.5 km from the Galiana entrance, on the esplanade that extends in front of the Cueva Grande, which features cave paintings.

stops.name: ermita de San Bartolomé
stops.detail: The chapel of San Bartolomé is a Romanesque construction from the first quarter of the 13th century with some Gothic influence.

stops.name: puente de los Siete Ojos
stops.detail: The second access point is located 12 km from the previous one, approximately halfway along the route, 9 km from the Ucero exit, and is the so-called Siete Ojos bridge, located on the provincial road SO-934, which connects San Leonardo de Yagüe with Santa María de las Hoyas.

stops.name: Casa del Parque
stops.detail: Near the Galiana entrance is the Casa del Parque, the interpretation center for the natural area.
